title: A Proper Hold
offer: You are real traders now: you need a real hold! Bring me eight planks from Frosttorp and two crates of iron tools, and pay 20 silver. Then your hold takes two more crates.

steps.load_say: Planks of pine, split with wedges. Stack them well!

steps.say: Saw, plane, rivets... Look at her! Longer, wider, and room for two more crates.

fact: Viking boats were built of overlapping planks, held with iron rivets.
